message:
feat: isolate research carrier ownership and physical carbon stores

Implement the frozen electricity-only intervention contract using country/node
H2/fuel/biomass/CO2 interfaces. Shared prices are metadata, finite resources
require accepted allocations, and geology has explicit no-withdrawal constraints.
Evidence: Phase3 cross-border/supply/carbon contracts; Gate3 static fragment tests.

feat: separate power policy co2 from system emissions reporting

Preserve all six absolute budgets and baseline disabled semantics. Use explicit
accepted component coefficients, not the whole-atmosphere Store. Require
shared SMR/CHP attribution, trace physical carbon once, and never add a full-system cap.
Validation: synthetic +1 sector events, capture/recycle/storage and unsolved Linopy coefficients.

test: add carrier reachability and carbon scope gates

Validate explicit config consumers, no scenario difference, no demand acceptance
changes and real PyPSA fragment semantics. Gate2 70 tests and input hashes preserved.
No optimisation, final network construction or topology repair.

fix: keep shared fuel prices independent of national availability

Separate common price provenance from country/node capacity and annual caps.
Validation: synthetic equal-price unequal-availability imports stay isolated;
all Gate3 tests and the unchanged Gate2 acceptance guard pass.
